    Class

    Entity representing an inpatient admission request lifecycle from emergency department triage through bed allocation, transfer, inpatient stay, and discharge.

    Entity representing an individual hospital bed within a ward, including its telemetry capabilities, proximity to the nursing station, cleaning status, and current occupancy.
